factor_diagnostics.value_notes: North Pacific research reports 20-25 °C as a preferred temperature range; California/Mexico recreational catch rates were highest around 22-24 °C, and longline analyses report 20-26 °C. These align well with the configured 18-26 °C range and 20-24 °C ideal. However, habitat is non-contiguous and stock/region/season effects are substantial, so this is not a universal global catch curve.
